verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਕੀ ਸੁਣ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਚਲੈ ਨਾ ਕਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kalijug kee sun saadhanaa karam kirat kee chalai naa kaiee|

en.bdb: Now listen to the discipline of kaliyug wherein nobody cares for the rituals.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਾ ਭਜਨ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਕੇ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਠਉੜਿ ਨਾ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: binaa bhajan bhagavaan ke bhaau bhagat bin ThauR naa paiee|

en.bdb: Without loving devotion none will get any place anywhere.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਹੇ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਏਤ ਜੁਗਿ ਪਿਛਲੀ ਜੁਗੀਂ ਕਰੀ ਕਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: lahe kamaanaa et jug pichhalee jugee(n) karee kamaiee|

en.bdb: Because of the disciplined life in the previous ages, the human form has been obtained in kaliyug.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹਿ ਕਉ ਐਥੌ ਚੁਕਿਆ ਠੌਰ ਨ ਠਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: paiaa maanas dheh kau aaithau chukiaa Thauar na Thaiee|

en.bdb: Now if this opportunity slipped, no occasion and place would be made available.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਕੇ ਉਪਕਾਰਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੇਦ ਅਥਰਵਣ ਗਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kalijug ke upakaar sun jaise bedh atharavan gaiee|

en.bdb: As has been said in the Atharvaveda, listen to the redeeming features of kaliyug.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਹੈ ਜਗ ਹੋਮ ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bhaau bhagat paravaan hai jag hom gurapurab kamaiee|

en.bdb: Now feeingful devotion only is acceptable; yajna, burnt offering and worship of the human guru was the discipline of the earlier ages.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕੇ ਨੀਚ ਸਦਾਵਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kar ke neech sadhaavanaa taa(n) prabh lekhai a(n)dhar paiee|

en.bdb: If somebody now, in spite of being a doer, erases from his self this sense and prefers to be called lowly, only then he can remain in the good books of the Lord.
In Kaliyug, only repeating the name of Lord is considered grand.
